planets.name: TOI-500 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-500 with a 0.548-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-500 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-500. Its orbit and size follow Serrano et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
